name: Kan'in Tokkyuu Matsuba ~Nikuyoku no Gourmet Kikou~
original_name: 姦淫特急 松葉～肉欲のグルメ紀行～
source:
The demand for "specialized" sex slaves in the underworld had grown, and to ensure a steady supply, a new express train was developed. While Michishio handled operations during the summer, this new train, Matsuba, was designed for winter operations.
A trap train, luring in even younger women.
The conductor responsible for turning these captured women into "livestock" aboard this new train? That would be me—Kaidou Seiji.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/appx/work/=/product_id/VJ011348.html]dlsite[/url]]
